description: Democrats in the U.S. Senate just handed Donald Trump’s GOP a great gift: an end to the government shutdown that had, just days before, been a key factor driving Republican election losses across the country. In other words, Democrats saved Republicans from themselves — and did so without winning anything in return that could be explained, clearly, to the American people.
